description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the 帝王会议 Multi-Agent framework structure and output format. (2) Create a file named `imperial_strategy_report.md` in the workspace. (3) The report must contain ALL required sections in order: '会议主题' (meeting topic), '主要矛盾分析' attributed to 毛主席 identifying the primary vs secondary contradictions in the internationalization problem, '各帝王观点' with all four named sub-sections for 秦始皇 (addressing 制度建设/standardization for overseas ops), 汉武帝 (addressing 对外战略/active expansion), 唐太宗 (addressing 用人纳谏/talent deployment), and 朱元璋 (addressing 群众动员/grassroots engagement). (4) The '统一决策' section must synthesize all views AND explicitly assign execution responsibilities to the named emperors (e.g., '秦始皇负责...'). (5) The '执行计划' section must be phased (at least 2-3 stages with time labels like '阶段1'/'第X月'). (6) CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP: The '实践检验标准' section (practice verification criteria) must exist and contain specific, quantifiable numeric metrics (e.g., percentages, numeric targets). This section is unique to the SKILL.md format and will be missed by an agent not reading the documentation. (7) The report must be primarily in Chinese and specifically address the internationalization expansion dilemmas described in the brief.
